title: Ex-OVP aide slams NBI obstruction charge recommendation

blocks.text: DAVAO CITY — A former official at the Office of the Vice President (OVP) on Wednesday denounced the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) for recommending charges against her regarding accusations by dismissed policeman Rodolfo Gracioso Jr. about cash deliveries to the Dutertes. “I denounce the NBI’s recommendation to file charges against me before the Department of Justice (DOJ). This is harassment, plain and simple,” Jeffrey Tupas said in a statement. Tupas, who once led the OVP’s Media and Public Relations Division, was accused by Gracioso of having received several cash deliveries on behalf of Vice President Sara Duterte.
